SEARCH

All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
ActionContext
What an action runs against: the run's facts and the output object.
ActionResult
What an action did: changed the output object itself (ActionResult.done()), or produced properties for the engine to set on it (ActionResult.set(Map)).
CompileContext
What every compilation of a rule list is given: the imports the engine was built with, from RulesEngineBuilder.imports(String...), the class loader to look classes up with, the type of the output object, this language's options, and a way to report warnings.
CompiledAction
A compiled action, shared by every run of its rule list.
CompiledCondition
A compiled condition, shared by every run of its rule list.
EvaluationContext
What a condition is evaluated against.
Expression
One condition or action of a rule, as an ExpressionCompiler compiles it: which rule it belongs to, whether it's the condition or the action, and its text.
ExpressionCompiler
Compiles the conditions and actions of one rule list, checks the names of the facts they run against, and creates the sessions they run with.
ExpressionKind
Which part of a rule an expression is.
ExpressionLanguage
A language that rule conditions and actions are written in, such as MVEL.
ExpressionLanguageContractTest
What the engine promises for rules in any expression language.
ExpressionLanguageContractTest.Applicant
An applicant, so a language's tests can run a rule against a record fact.
ExpressionLanguageContractTest.ApplicantBean
An applicant as a JavaBean, so a language's tests can run a rule against a fact whose property is a getter.
Fact<T>
The built-in, immutable FactReference.
FactMap<T>
The built-in FactStore: a map from each fact's name to its FactReference, backed by a HashMap.
FactProperties
Reads a property of a fact the way rules expect: a record component, a JavaBean getter or a Map key.
FactReference<T>
A named value that rules run against.
FactStore<T>
A store of facts, each kept under its name.
InvalidExpressionException
Thrown by an ExpressionCompiler to reject an expression: one that breaks a rule the engine enforces, such as a condition that assigns to a fact, or one with an error the language can point to, such as a syntax error.
InvalidExpressionException.Issue
One problem a language found in an expression.
InvalidExpressionException.Issue.Severity
Whether an issue stops an expression compiling.
LanguageTestContexts
Creates the contexts the engine passes to an expression language, for unit tests of a language's compiler and compiled expressions.
LoggingRuleListener
A RuleListener that logs each rule's callbacks through SLF4J at DEBUG: beforeEvaluate, afterEvaluate, beforeExecute, afterExecute and onError.
MvelExpressionLanguage
MVEL 2 as an expression language for the engine, named "mvel".
OutputWriter<O>
Sets a property on the output object.
Rule
A rule: a condition that decides whether it fires, and an action that runs when it does, with a name, a priority and the language they're written in.
Rule.RuleBuilder
Builds a Rule.
RuleCompilationException
Exception thrown when a rule fails to compile, or when several do.
RuleEvaluation
What a run found out about one rule: whether its condition was true, false, or never evaluated, or whether the run skipped the rule.
RuleEvaluation.Outcome
What evaluating a rule's condition found, or that the run skipped the rule.
RuleExecutionException
Thrown by run() when a run fails: because a rule's condition or action failed, or because something outside any rule did.
RuleListener
A listener interface to hook into the lifecycle of rule evaluation and execution.
RulesEngine<O>
Runs rules against facts: it evaluates each Rule's condition and fires the actions of the rules that match, as its match policy decides.
RulesEngineBuilder<O>
Configures and builds a RulesEngine.
RuleSetInfo
The rules an engine has loaded, from RulesEngine.rules(): the rules themselves, a checksum that identifies them, and when they were loaded.
RunContext
One run of an engine, given to RuleListener's run callbacks.
RunOptions
Settings for one run, given to RulesEngine.runWithResult(FactStore, RunOptions).
RunResult<O>
What one run did: the output object, the rules that fired, what each rule's condition evaluated to, the checksum of the rules it used, and the tags and start time that chose which of them it used.
Session
A language's state for one run of a rule list at a time, such as a single-threaded interpreter context.
UnrulyException
The base runtime exception for the Unruly engine.
